name: Vitre Menus
description: Glass menus for the top bar and beyond. The glass stretches out of the button you clicked and stays attached until it lands as the menu; closing plays it back. Covers top bar menus, app menus, Dock menus and other shell menus. Also owns the shared drip-style setting (liquid | classic) that Vitre Controls, Vitre Notices and the menu-bar HUD read. Disabling restores every menu exactly.
